# specification_curve

> Specification curve analysis for econometrics, built on pyfixest

## Docs

### API Reference

#### Classes
> The main entry point. Describe the specifications, estimate them, and plot the curve.

- [SpecificationCurve](https://aeturrell.github.io/specification_curve/reference/SpecificationCurve.html): Runs and plots every variant of a regression specification

#### Functions
> Plot a results table directly, and select subsets of specifications.

- [plot_curve](https://aeturrell.github.io/specification_curve/reference/plot_curve.html): Draws a specification curve
- [subsets_by](https://aeturrell.github.io/specification_curve/reference/subsets_by.html): Builds a ``subsets`` argument with one sample per level of a column

#### Example data
> Data sets used in the documentation and tests.

- [load_example_panel](https://aeturrell.github.io/specification_curve/reference/load_example_panel.html): Generates a synthetic firm-year panel
- [load_example_data1](https://aeturrell.github.io/specification_curve/reference/load_example_data1.html): Retrieves example data from a file included with the package
- [load_example_data2](https://aeturrell.github.io/specification_curve/reference/load_example_data2.html): Generates example data with one outcome and four regressors
- [load_example_data3](https://aeturrell.github.io/specification_curve/reference/load_example_data3.html): Generates example data with two outcomes, where the true effect of x1 is 0.4
